promptConfig.specialInstructions:
Category-specific rules:
- Motor power (W) is the nominal/rated power, not peak power — do not conflate the two if both are mentioned.
- Assisted top speed reflects the legal pedelec class (25 km/h EU pedelec, 45 km/h S-pedelec) — do not confuse with the bike's actual maximum speed under manual pedaling.
- Range is highly ride-condition-dependent (terrain, assist level, rider weight) — only extract as a spec when the commenter states manufacturer/official range, not their own real-world mileage anecdote (that belongs in review quotes/features instead).
- Frame type describes physical geometry (e.g. step-through, full-suspension); usage type describes the riding discipline (e.g. trekking, urban) — do not conflate the two fields even though some values sound similar (e.g. 'Cross' appears in both).

useCases.label: commuting
useCases.description: Daily commuting to work or school — reliability, range for round trips, comfort, weather protection

useCases.label: trekking
useCases.description: Long-distance touring and trekking rides — endurance, comfort, range, luggage capacity

useCases.label: mountain biking
useCases.description: Off-road trail riding — suspension performance, traction, climbing torque, durability

useCases.label: urban riding
useCases.description: City riding — maneuverability, compact size, traffic-friendly handling, parking/storage

useCases.label: cargo and family
useCases.description: Carrying cargo, groceries, or children — load capacity, stability, rack/basket compatibility

features.label: motor power
features.description: Perceived strength and responsiveness of motor assistance, including hill-climbing ability

features.label: torque
features.description: Pulling power felt when accelerating or climbing, independent of top-end motor power

features.label: range
features.description: Real-world distance achieved on a single charge under typical riding conditions

features.label: battery life
features.description: Long-term battery capacity retention and charge-cycle degradation over time

features.label: build quality
features.description: Frame and component materials, welds, overall fit and finish, physical durability

features.label: comfort
features.description: Riding position, saddle comfort, vibration damping, suitability for long rides

features.label: handling
features.description: Steering responsiveness, stability at speed, and balance when loaded or cornering

features.label: suspension performance
features.description: How well the fork/rear shock absorbs bumps and impacts on rough terrain

features.label: brake performance
features.description: Stopping power, modulation, and reliability of the braking system

features.label: display and controls
features.description: Readability and usability of the onboard display, buttons, and ride-mode switching

features.label: app connectivity
features.description: Companion app features — GPS tracking, theft alerts, ride stats, firmware updates

features.label: value
features.description: Price-to-performance ratio, deal quality, and whether the price is justified

features.label: weight
features.description: How manageable the bike feels to lift, carry, or maneuver when unpowered

issues.label: battery degradation
issues.description: Noticeable loss of range or charge capacity over time

issues.label: motor cutout
issues.description: Motor assistance intermittently stopping or failing to engage

issues.label: display malfunction
issues.description: Display freezing, blanking out, or showing incorrect readings

issues.label: brake squeal
issues.description: Audible noise from the brakes during normal use

issues.label: creaking frame
issues.description: Unwanted noise from the frame or components under load

issues.label: app connectivity issues
issues.description: Companion app failing to pair, sync, or maintain a stable connection
